title: T009 ContentDocument v1 contract proof updated
summary: T009 defines a closed-world ContentDocument v1 schema and bounded fixtures. The contract keeps video providerId at a rights-pending sentinel until ADR-0003 approval, enumerates the approved court-dusk palette, accepts UUIDv7 identifiers, rejects malformed HTTPS authority/ports and NUL characters, covers 21 focused schema-invalid fixtures across all 11 block types, and records a duplicate block-ID semantic invariant. Independent Ajv/Prettier replay passes; current-head GitHub CI/Security and review-thread revalidation remain pending, followed by human merge and main read-back.

claims.text: T009 was dispatched from main@a75f1c2 after Phase 1 PASS read-back.
The contract must represent exactly 11 approved MVP block types.
generative-canvas is limited to court-pulse-v1, fixed seed, bounded parameters, poster asset, alt text and data summary.
T010 validator parity and generated types are not part of this slice.
Independent Ajv 8 strict validation accepted the complete fixture and rejected all 21 schema-invalid fixtures; the duplicate-ID semantic fixture was detected separately.
T009 does not authorize an external video provider; providerId is the rights-pending sentinel until ADR-0003 publisher/rights-owner approval.
Every approved block type has a focused invalid fixture, and generative code, shader and remote URL fields are tested independently.
Block IDs must be unique even when payloads differ; this semantic invariant is declared in the contract and must be enforced by T010 validators.
Required human-readable strings reject whitespace-only values through a non-whitespace schema pattern.
HTTPS hrefs use URI format plus a bounded authority/port pattern; malformed authorities and ports are rejected.
The locked repository validator was replayed independently with Node 24.14.0, Ajv 8.20.0 and ajv-formats 3.0.1; current-head GitHub CI/Security and review-thread revalidation are pending.
The schema accepts UUIDv7 identifiers required by the data model.
All persisted string definitions reject NUL characters before JSONB persistence.
Repository CI runs scripts/validate-content-schema.mjs through pnpm run contract:schema.

decision.context: Phase 1 setup/governance and CI/security baseline are complete; dependent implementation requires a versioned content contract first.
decision.chosen: Define a closed-world JSON Schema and fixtures before implementing validators or renderers.
alternatives: Start T010 validator code without a canonical schema.
Define permissive payloads and enforce safety only in renderers.
tradeoffs: Schema is safer and reviewable at the boundary.
Provider allowlists and runtime parity still require T010/T011 evidence.
Rights-pending video sentinel preserves the ADR rights gate; approved provider values remain a later decision.
decision.invalidation: If ADR-0003/0005 or tasks.md changes the allowed block/preset contract, mark this record needs_update and stop T009.
decision.proof: Ajv strict validation passed the valid fixture and rejected 19 focused schema-invalid fixtures; the duplicate block-ID semantic invariant, non-whitespace text boundary and host-required HTTPS boundary were independently checked; Graphify and memory validation remain required gates. Current-head CI and Security pass, and review threads are resolved; this is not a merge or main read-back proof.
